assessments.source_anchor: Generates Angular code and provides architectural guidance.
assessments.rationale: This skill covers Angular component generation, dependency injection, project-aware guidance, and component testing, so it can add the preferences panel in the existing Angular feature while preserving local module and test conventions.

assessments.source_anchor: Designs the minimal set of test doubles for a unit or integration test

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: An Angular component implementation workflow that follows the existing feature's module and test conventions.
